title: A special day in Sitges
text:
We had a wonderful experience on the private excursion to Sitges. From the beginning everything was very well organized, with comfortable transport from Barcelona and a very relaxed atmosphere throughout the day.
We loved Sitges: it is a beautiful village, with lots of charm, beautiful streets, amazing beaches and a very special Mediterranean atmosphere. Our guide taught us the highlights, but we also had free time to stroll, enjoy the boardwalk and discover the historic center at our own pace.

title: Unique and beautiful
text: We offered this surprise to my friend for her 30s birthday and we were not disappointed! We had an absolute blast. The place is lovely, it's in a yoga retreat center if I'l not wrong. Really beautiful, all local wines are delicious and the staff so nice. 100% recommend if you want an experience out of the city but not too far and something convenient with transport included!
author: ophelieg1706

title: Amazing tour with Wine Stories!
text: I just went on a wine tour with Wine Stories and had a great time! The tour was well-organized, and the guide was knowledgeable and friendly. We visited some beautiful wineries and enjoyed tasting a variety of excellent wines. It was a relaxed and enjoyable experience, perfect for anyone who loves wine or just wants to learn more about it. Definitely recommend if you're looking for a nice day out!
author: 265kristiem

title: So grateful for this experience, thank you winestories!!!
text: My friends and I loved every minute of the wine tour! The itinerary was fantastic, taking us to some charming wineries where we got to taste a variety of delicious wines. Our guide was passionate and made the whole experience enjoyable with their engaging stories and insights. The whole day was well-paced, allowing us to enjoy the beautiful scenery and savor each tasting without feeling rushed. You can even add a professional photoshoot to capture some stunning shots!😍
author: 442kajab

title: Wonderful evening
text: It was a great experience and a wonderful evening. The team took excellent care of us. We have wonderful memories. Thank you very much.
